# Factur-X Engine — archived project context

Factur-X Engine was a self-hosted Docker API for technical electronic-invoice
workflows. It processed supported Factur-X/ZUGFeRD CII and XRechnung UBL
documents without sending invoice payloads to a Factur-X Engine hosted service.

The project was discontinued on 24 August 2026. Version 2.1.0 is the final
frozen release. There will be no support, security fixes, vulnerability
monitoring, regulatory monitoring, or standards updates. Do not adopt it as a
maintained production dependency.

Repository: https://github.com/facturx-engine/facturx-engine

## Frozen runtime

    docker run -d -p 8000:8000 --name facturx-engine \
      facturxengine/facturx-engine:2.1.0

The former commercial evaluation ended on 24 August 2026. No new evaluation or
commercial keys are issued.

## Responsibility boundary

Factur-X Engine is a document-processing component. An API success is not tax,
accounting, legal, regulatory, or security advice and does not guarantee
recipient, portal, auditor, or tax-authority acceptance.

Validation results describe only the rules and tools that actually ran. Inspect
`validation_completeness`, `layers_executed`, `layers_skipped`, and
`pdfa_valid` where relevant. The caller retains supplier matching, duplicate
detection, purchase-order matching, tax-policy, payment, filing, reporting, and
acceptance decisions.

## Frozen endpoints

- `POST /v1/validate`: technical validation evidence
- `POST /v1/extract`: heuristic, non-importable preview
- `POST /v1/serialize`: strict schema-v2 mapping when enabled
- `POST /v1/xml`: supported CII generation
- `POST /v1/convert`: CII generation and PDF embedding
- `POST /v1/merge`: existing XML and PDF/A-3 embedding
- `GET /health`: liveness
- `GET /healthz`: readiness and validator-tool probe

All published source code remains available as-is under the MIT licence. Anyone
continuing to use it must maintain a fork or choose a maintained alternative.
